narration: In month {fork_month}, you took {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, in month {first_bar_apart_month}. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. None of the ghost's pay was left unclaimed before the month began, with Freedom at {ghost_freedom}. On Life, the ghost finished {life_gap}.
